sections.heading: History
sections.text:
This Suit attacked Lok Lambert and Sophie Casterwill to retrieve the Eathon's journal. He invoked a Mindrone and was a part of the team that cornered Lok outside of Dante Vale's house. This Suit was defeated when Dante Vale intervened and defeated the Titan with Solwing. [A Seeker Is Born]

He was one of the many Suits called in by DeFoe to stop Dante Vale, Lok Lambert, and Sophie Casterwill in the Venice Huntik Library. This Suit, along with the others, was defeated by Dante's team and Santiago. [The Casterwill Client] They did, however, acquire the Foundation's clue regarding the Golem, and his team of Suits gained Jodis Lore's Key for the Organization. [Words of Truth, Heart of Lies]

The team was later sent to Rouen, France, to retrieve Gar-Ghoul. [Into the River of Secrets] However, they missed the more important information on the Ring of Arc and were then sent by the Professor to Paris, France, following Dante's team into the Paris Catacombs. [Crawling the Catacombs] However, his team was unsuccessful at retrieving the Ring. [Divide and Conquer]

This Suit was later a part of the investigation of the Basilisk House and the Amulet of King Basilisk. He was entrusted with a key which was given to DeFoe to enter an underground labyrinth. Upon reaching the chamber containing King Basilisk, this Suit was turned to stone when he looked at the head of the mural of King Basilisk. [Absent Heroes] He was later released by Sophie's Breakspell power, which Zhalia and Lok discussed following the mission. [Huntik.com Webisode 9]

This Suit was later sent to Zhalia Moon's apartment to eliminate her following her betrayal of the Organization. After the building exploded, he assumed that Zhalia had perished in the blaze and reported her as dead. [The Unseen Guide]

History

This Suit, along with the others, was defeated by Dante's team and Santiago. [The Casterwill Client] They did, however, acquire the Foundation's clue regarding the Golem, and his team of Suits gained Jodis Lore's Key for the Organization. [Words of Truth, Heart of Lies]

The team was later sent to Rouen, France, to retrieve Gar-Ghoul. [Into the River of Secrets] However, they missed the more important information on the Ring of Arc and were then sent by the Professor to Paris, France, following Dante's team into the Paris Catacombs.
